paite: Huchibang in Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; ngai dih ua, haichi poi nanungzaw pen adot pat tungna ah khaukhup abawl a; ngai dih ua, kumpipa tangseu khit a pou nanungzaw ahi.
heading: Khaupehon Muhna

paite: Huan huchi ahong hi a, huai gam a loupa anek khit nung un, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ngaidam in, ka hon ngen ahi; bangchi in Jakob adingh thei dia? Amah lah aneu ngal a," ka chi hi.
Hiai thu ah TOUPA'N alung hei in, "TOUPA'N, hiai hong tung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Huchibang in, Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; huan en dih ua, Toupa PATHIAN mei a dou ding in asam a; mei in tui thuk lian akang khin a, gam leng kat a-ut lai hi.
heading: Meikuang Muhna

paite: Ke'n, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, khawl in ka hon ngen ahi; bangchi in Jakob adingh thei dia? Amah lah aneu ngal a," ka chi hi.
Hiai thu ah TOUPA'N alungsim hei in, "Toupa PATHIAN in, huai leng ahong tung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Hichibang in ahon ensak a; ngai dih ua, TOUPA bel ulum a bawl baang kiang ah adingh a, akhut a ulum toh.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA'N, "Amos, bang na mu a?" achi a. Ke'n, "Ulum," ka chi hi. TOUPA'N, “Ngai in, ka mi, Israelte lak ah ulum ka koih ding a; amau ka paikheng nawnta kei ding;
Isak mun sangte ahong segawp ding a, Israel mun siangthoute hihsiat ahi ding ua; Jeroboam inkote namsau in ka dou ding," achi hi.
Huan Bethel kho siampu Amaziah in Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kiang ah, "Amos in Israel inkote lak ah nang hon kalh a; gam in athu tengteng athuak thei kei," chi in.
heading: Amos Leh Amaziah

paite: Amos in lah hichi in achi ngal a, “Jeroboam namsau in asi ding, pel lou in agam a kipan in Israel sal in apikhe ding," chi in thu akhak hi.
Huan Amos kiang ah Amaziah in, "Aw nang zawlnei, kuan inla, Judah gam ah taimang in, huai ah an ne inla, thu hilh in.
Himahleh Bethel ah thu hilh nawn ke'n; kumpipa mun siangthou leh kumpipa' inn ahih ziak in," achi lai hi.
Huan Amaziah kiang ah Amos in, "Zawlnei ka hi kei a, zawlnei tapa leng ka hi sam kei; ganhon vengpa leh theipi sing kempa ka hi zaw hi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, 'Kuan inla, ka mi Israelte kiang ah thu gen in,' hon chi hi.
Huchi in tu in TOUPA thu za in; nang Israel kalh in thu gen ke'nla, Isak inkote kalh in thu khak ke'n, na chih.

Huaiziak in ToUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Khopi ah na zi kizuaknu ahi ding a, na tapate, na tanute namsau in apuk ding ua, tehna khau in na gam ahawm ding ua; nang leng siang lou mun ah na si ding a; pel lou in Israel a gam a kipan sal in apimang ding uh, achi,' " chi in adawng hi.
